UnionOrder gains optional platform-neutral fields filled by the pdd mapping (sub_order_id = order_sn, promotion_slot = pid, attr_params with custom_parameters verbatim, raw_status as string, five instants as Date or null, est / settle commission, raw_payload_id); PddOrderFields and makeUnionOrder unchanged. The archive insert returns its id, attached as a non-enumerable raw_payload_id on the same inner response object (frozen archive tests compare identity and plain equality); not attached when the insert fails or has no context. The demo adapter keeps no order feed. No contract, migration or money change.
